name: Build a 3-qubit GHZ circuit in pytket, export it to OpenQASM 2 with circuit_to_q
task_prompt: Build a 3-qubit GHZ circuit in pytket, export it to OpenQASM 2 with circuit_to_qasm_str, then re-import it and check the round trip preserves the statevector. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
